title: Cosmic Portal Flower
description: A massive, vibrant swirling flower with glowing neon petals in pink, purple, green and orange emerges from the center of an ancient ruined stone archway. The arch is covered in turquoise moss and carved markings reading '1 2 6', set against a dark, starry night sky with purple nebulae and broken classical columns on either side.
